records.variant: UTC as defined since 1961-01-01: 1961-1971 offsets with rate terms, integer leap seconds from 1972
records.conditions: TAI - UTC = offset_s + (MJD_UTC - mjd_reference) * rate_s_per_day from jd_utc_start; the 1972+ steps are cross-checked against NAIF DELTET/DELTA_AT at build time.
records.uncertainty: Exact by definition (IERS Bulletin C / BIH); valid until the next announced leap second.

records.source: IERS Earth Orientation Centre, Paris Observatory, EOP (IERS) 20 C04 daily series 1962-now, consistent with ITRF 2020: https://hpiers.obspm.fr/iers/eop/eopc04/eopc04.1962-now (rows through 2026   6  30   0, prefix SHA-256 a26cf3eb29bdcfa6d2f8a31ded0b826cc0eb20ca66805cb93bcf0677710b3bb2). records.variant: IERS EOP 20 C04, daily at 0h UTC, 1962-01-01 to 2026-06-30
records.conditions: Polar motion, UT1-UTC, LOD and celestial pole offsets as observed; after the last row the orientation holds its last values with a growing, declared error.
records.uncertainty: Per-row published 1-sigma: 0.02 arcsec (~0.6 m) and 1.5 ms (~0.7 m at the equator) in 1969; ~50 microarcsec and ~20 microseconds today.

records.variant: CIP X, Y and CIO locator s, daily at 0h TT, 1960-01-01 to 2051-12-31
records.conditions: Pure IAU model; observed corrections dX, dY come from eop_c04. Interpolated with 8-point Lagrange in the simulation.
records.uncertainty: IAU 2006/2000A model accuracy ~0.2 mas against VLBI before dX/dY; interpolation error tested below 1 microarcsec.

records.variant: GRGM1200A truncated to degree and order 120, 4pi normalized, DE430 lunar principal axes
records.conditions: Applied in the DE440 principal-axes frame without a DE430->DE440 correction; NAIF does not publish DE430 librations. NAIF's measured DE421/DE440 frame difference (<= 5.8e-7 rad, 1900-2051) bounds it at ~1-2 m on the surface.
records.uncertainty: Published coefficient sigmas per row; truncation error at 100 km altitude reported by the C# suite for the selected degree.
